## Subset of the essential variables

```{r}
# Subsetting BDNF data to include only specific columns
bdnf_subset <- subset(bdnf, select = c(ID, Standort, Zeitpunkt, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel))

# Subsetting BDNF CpG columns and calculating mean and median values for each row
bdnf_methylation <- subset(bdnf, select = c(m148:p020))
bdnf_methylation_mean <- apply(bdnf_methylation, 1, mean, na.rm=TRUE)
bdnf_methylation_median <- apply(bdnf_methylation, 1, median, na.rm=TRUE)

# Combining the subset data with the calculated mean and median values
bdnf_mean <- cbind(bdnf_subset, bdnf_methylation_mean)
colnames(bdnf_mean)[8] <- "Mean"
bdnf_median <- cbind(bdnf_subset, bdnf_methylation_median)
colnames(bdnf_median)[8] <- "Median"

# Removing rows with specific IDs due to data issues
bdnf_mean <- bdnf_mean[!(bdnf_mean$ID %in% c(192, 193)), ]
bdnf_mean[bdnf_mean$ID >= 190 & bdnf_mean$ID <= 196, ] # Display rows to verify deletion

bdnf_median <- bdnf_median[!(bdnf_median$ID %in% c(192, 193)), ]
bdnf_median[bdnf_median$ID >= 190 & bdnf_median$ID <= 196, ] # Display rows to verify deletion

bdnf_mean[1:5,]
bdnf_median[1:5,]
```

```{r}
#| label: make-gene-mean-median-clean
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)

# ---- utilities ----
dedup_names_keep_first <- function(df) df[, !duplicated(names(df)), drop = FALSE]

first_nonmiss <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA else x[1]
}

calc_bmi <- function(height_cm, weight_kg) {
  h_m <- height_cm / 100
  bmi <- weight_kg / (h_m^2)
  bmi[is.infinite(bmi)] <- NA
  bmi
}

# Select CpG columns safely between two names (inclusive)
select_cpg_block <- function(df, start_name, end_name) {
  i1 <- match(start_name, names(df))
  i2 <- match(end_name, names(df))
  stopifnot(!is.na(i1), !is.na(i2))
  if (i1 > i2) { tmp <- i1; i1 <- i2; i2 <- tmp }
  df[, i1:i2, drop = FALSE]
}

# Build mean/median table for one gene dataset
make_gene_tables <- function(df,
                             meta_cols,                # meta columns as they exist in df
                             rename_map = NULL,        # named vector old->new
                             cpg_start, cpg_end,
                             drop_ids = integer(0)) {

  df <- dedup_names_keep_first(df)

  # meta
  meta <- df[, meta_cols, drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(rename_map)) {
    # rename_map is c(old="new", ...)
    for (old in names(rename_map)) {
      if (old %in% names(meta)) names(meta)[names(meta) == old] <- rename_map[[old]]
    }
  }

  # CpGs
  cpg <- select_cpg_block(df, cpg_start, cpg_end)

  # sanity: CpGs numeric
  # (if some are character, coerce safely)
  cpg_num <- suppressWarnings(as.data.frame(lapply(cpg, as.numeric)))
  stopifnot(nrow(meta) == nrow(cpg_num))

  out_mean <- meta
  out_mean$Mean <- rowMeans(cpg_num, na.rm = TRUE)

  out_median <- meta
  out_median$Median <- apply(cpg_num, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

  # drop problematic IDs everywhere (all timepoints)
  if (length(drop_ids) > 0) {
    out_mean   <- out_mean[!(out_mean$ID %in% drop_ids), , drop = FALSE]
    out_median <- out_median[!(out_median$ID %in% drop_ids), , drop = FALSE]
  }

  list(mean = out_mean, median = out_median)
}

# ---- YOUR SETTINGS ----
drop_ids <- c(192, 193)

# ---- BDNF ----
bdnf_tabs <- make_gene_tables(
  df = bdnf,
  meta_cols = c("ID", "Standort", "Zeitpunkt", "Gruppe", "Sex", "Age_start", "CogTel"),
  rename_map = NULL,
  cpg_start = "m148",
  cpg_end   = "p020",
  drop_ids  = drop_ids
)
bdnf_mean   <- bdnf_tabs$mean
bdnf_median <- bdnf_tabs$median

# ---- TAU ----
tau_tabs <- make_gene_tables(
  df = tau,
  meta_cols = c("ID", "standort_aus_andere_quelle", "Zeit", "Gruppe", "Sex", "Age_start", "CogTel"),
  rename_map = c("standort_aus_andere_quelle" = "Standort",
                 "Zeit" = "Zeitpunkt"),
  cpg_start = "m331",
  cpg_end   = "p27",
  drop_ids  = drop_ids
)
tau_mean   <- tau_tabs$mean
tau_median <- tau_tabs$median

# ---- PSD95 ----
psd95_tabs <- make_gene_tables(
  df = psd95,
  meta_cols = c("ID", "standort_aus_andere_quelle", "Zeitpunkt", "Gruppe", "Sex", "Age_start", "CogTel"),
  rename_map = c("standort_aus_andere_quelle" = "Standort"),
  cpg_start = "m465",
  cpg_end   = "p122",
  drop_ids  = drop_ids
)
psd95_mean   <- psd95_tabs$mean
psd95_median <- psd95_tabs$median

# ---- OPTIONAL: add BMI + extra covariates if they exist in any df ----
# If height/weight/smoking/etc are in the gene dfs (as in your later tables),
# merge them in by ID+Zeitpunkt+Standort+Gruppe (or whichever keys you trust).
# Example for BDNF only (adjust keys to your reality):

time_to_char <- function(z) {
  # converts 0/1/2 -> T0/T1/T2; keeps T0/T1/T2 as-is; otherwise plain character
  if (is.numeric(z) || is.integer(z)) {
    out <- paste0("T", as.integer(z))
    return(out)
  }
  z <- as.character(z)
  z <- trimws(z)
  # if it's already like T0/T1/T2 keep it
  z
}

add_covars_if_present <- function(gene_df, source_df) {
  wanted <- c("B09a_groesse","B09b_gewicht","rauchen","B14a_rauchen",
              "B15a_alkoholkonsum","B16_nehmen_sie_medikamente","B17a_nehmen_sie_drogen",
              "C05_familienstatus","C06_bildungsgrad")
  avail <- intersect(wanted, names(source_df))
  if (length(avail) == 0) return(gene_df)

  # ensure join keys exist
  join_keys <- intersect(c("ID","Standort","Zeitpunkt"), names(gene_df))
  join_keys <- intersect(join_keys, names(source_df))
  if (!all(c("ID","Zeitpunkt") %in% join_keys)) return(gene_df)  # minimal keys

  x <- gene_df %>%
    mutate(
      Zeitpunkt = time_to_char(Zeitpunkt)
    )

  y <- source_df %>%
    mutate(
      Zeitpunkt = time_to_char(Zeitpunkt)
    ) %>%
    select(any_of(c(join_keys, avail))) %>%
    distinct()

  out <- x %>% left_join(y, by = join_keys)

  # BMI if possible
  if (all(c("B09a_groesse","B09b_gewicht") %in% names(out))) {
    out <- out %>% mutate(BMI = calc_bmi(B09a_groesse, B09b_gewicht))
  }
  out
}

# If your original dfs contain these covariates, you can do:
bdnf_mean   <- add_covars_if_present(bdnf_mean, bdnf)
bdnf_median <- add_covars_if_present(bdnf_median, bdnf)
tau_mean    <- add_covars_if_present(tau_mean, tau)
tau_median  <- add_covars_if_present(tau_median, tau)
psd95_mean  <- add_covars_if_present(psd95_mean, psd95)
psd95_median<- add_covars_if_present(psd95_median, psd95)

# ---- quick checks ----
stopifnot(!any(bdnf_mean$ID %in% drop_ids), !any(bdnf_median$ID %in% drop_ids))
stopifnot(!any(tau_mean$ID %in% drop_ids),  !any(tau_median$ID %in% drop_ids))
stopifnot(!any(psd95_mean$ID %in% drop_ids), !any(psd95_median$ID %in% drop_ids))

dplyr::glimpse(bdnf_mean)
dplyr::glimpse(tau_mean)
dplyr::glimpse(psd95_mean)

```

## Pivot time points to columns

```{r}
# Define the two split_zeitpunkt functions for mean and median
split_zeitpunkt_mean <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ID, Standort, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel), # no doublets!
                names_from = Zeitpunkt, # Pivot Zeitpunkt from long to wide format
                values_from = Mean)
}

split_zeitpunkt_median <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ID, Standort, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel), # no doublets!
                names_from = Zeitpunkt, # Pivot Zeitpunkt from long to wide format
                values_from = Median)
}

# Run the function and check the first few rows

# Apply to BDNF mean data
bdnf_mean_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_mean(bdnf_mean)
head(bdnf_mean_wide)
nrow(bdnf_mean_wide) # Expecting 144 rows

# Apply to BDNF median data
bdnf_median_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_median(bdnf_median)
head(bdnf_median_wide)
nrow(bdnf_median_wide) # Expecting 144 rows

# Apply to Tau mean data
tau_mean_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_mean(tau_mean)
head(tau_mean_wide)
nrow(tau_mean_wide) # Expecting 145 rows

# Apply to Tau median data
tau_median_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_median(tau_median)
head(tau_median_wide)
nrow(tau_median_wide) # Expecting 145 rows

# Apply to PSD95 mean data
psd95_mean_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_mean(psd95_mean)
head(psd95_mean_wide)
nrow(psd95_mean_wide) # Expecting 145 rows

# Apply to PSD95 median data
psd95_median_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_median(psd95_median)
head(psd95_median_wide)
nrow(psd95_median_wide) # Expecting 145 rows
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(T2), !is.na(T0)) %>%
```

```{r}
tau_mean_T1T0$CogTel <- as.numeric(tau_mean_T1T0$CogTel)
tau_mean_T1T0$Standort <- as.character(tau_mean_T1T0$Standort)
is.numeric(tau_mean_T1T0$CogTel)
is.character(tau_mean_T1T0$Standort)

head(tau_mean_T1T0)

# Tau median
tau_median_T1T0 <- tau_median_wide
tau_median_T1T0$T2 <- NULL

tau_median_T1T0 <- tau_median_T1T0 %>%
  filter(!is.na(T1), !is.na(T0)) %>%
  mutate(`T1_T0` = T1 - T0) # Calculate T1 - T0

tau_median_T1T0$CogTel <- as.numeric(tau_median_T1T0$CogTel)
tau_median_T1T0$Standort <- as.character(tau_median_T1T0$Standort)
is.numeric(tau_median_T1T0$CogTel)
is.character(tau_median_T1T0$Standort)

head(tau_median_T1T0)
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(T2), !is.na(T1)) %>%
  mutate(`T2_T1` = T2 - T1) # Calculate T2 - T1

bdnf_mean_T2T1$CogTel <- as.numeric(bdnf_mean_T2T1$CogTel)
bdnf_mean_T2T1$Standort <- as.character(bdnf_mean_T2T1$Standort)
is.numeric(bdnf_mean_T2T1$CogTel)
is.character(bdnf_mean_T2T1$Standort)

# BDNF median
bdnf_median_T2T1 <- bdnf_median_wide
bdnf_median_T2T1$T0 <- NULL

bdnf_median_T2T1 <- bdnf_median_T2T1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(T2), !is.na(T1)) %>%
```
